WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, st.format, st.store_id
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key)
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'),
r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(quantity_returned) rq, sum(refund_net) rn, count(*) rl FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.format, s.staff_purchase_flag staff, count(*) lines, sum(s.quantity) units, sum(s.net_amount) net, sum(coalesce(r.rq,0)) ret_units, sum(coalesce(r.rn,0)) ret_net, count(r.sales_line_id) ret_lines,
 round(100*sum(coalesce(r.rn,0))/sum(s.net_amount),3) val_rate, round(100*sum(coalesce(r.rq,0))/sum(s.quantity),3) unit_rate, round(100.0*count(r.sales_line_id)/count(*),3) line_rate
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(sales_line_id) GROUP BY ROLLUP(1,2) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT st.format, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(f.net_amount*r.quantity_returned/f.quantity) prorata_net, sum(r.refund_gross) rg, sum(f.gross_amount*r.quantity_returned/f.quantity) prorata_gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.refund_net - f.net_amount*r.quantity_returned/f.quantity)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatches,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.vat_rate<>f.vat_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vatdiff,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned=f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) full_ret, avg(f.net_amount/f.quantity) avg_ret_price
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag GROUP BY 1

SELECT p.category, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.net_amount/f.quantity) minp, count(DISTINCT p.sku) skus, 
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND s.sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)) stg_missing,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) badver
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND st.store_id<900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, st.format
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND st.store_id < 900
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY sales_line_id
)
SELECT s.format AS store_format,
       round(100 * sum(coalesce(r.refund_net, 0)) / sum(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY s.format
